title: LA Colossal – Cloisonné 01 (Standing)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her late 30s, black hair in a high sleek bun with a gold hairpin, natural face with a composed smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body cloisonné enamel body painting in jingtailan style, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no qipao, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Glossy turquoise-blue enamel base divided by raised gold wire outlines, filled with lotus scrolls, peonies, and cloud bands in coral red, cobalt, and white. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, both hands clasped loosely behind her lower back, shoulders drawn back, chest and belly facing the camera. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch turquoise enamel platform T-strap stiletto sandals with raised gold wire on every strap.
Nails: Extra long stiletto nails, turquoise with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Museum gallery of Ming cloisonné vessels in glass cases, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm museum key with raking side light making the gold wires glow. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
